title: Courier Handover Standard and Permitted Order Contents by Delivery & Pickup Services Plan
content:
The handover settings and the kinds of items an order may carry are set per plan of Kestrel Delivery & Pickup Services. The signature value threshold is the order value at or above which a signature is needed on handover; $0.00 means the plan's every-order signature setting governs alone.

## Handover settings

| Setting | Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | Kestrel Mail Delivery | Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | Kestrel Specialty Courier Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Every order needs a signature | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Order value at or above which a signature is needed | $250.00 | $500.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 | $250.00 | $0.00 |
| Recipient's photo ID checked on an order carrying a controlled substance | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| An order needing no signature may be left at the door | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | no |

## Permitted contents

| Contents | Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery | Kestrel Mail Delivery | Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass | Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual | Kestrel Specialty Courier Service |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controlled-substance prescriptions | yes | no | yes | yes | yes | no |
| Temperature-controlled items | no | no | no | no | no | yes |
| Non-prescription store items | yes | no | yes | yes | yes | no |

## Hypothetical orders

| Plan | Order value | Signature needed on account of plan setting or value |
|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | $249.99 | no |
| Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly | $250.00 | yes |
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | $320.00 | no |
| Kestrel Mail Delivery | $500.00 | yes |
| Kestrel Specialty Courier Service | $40.00 | yes (every order) |
